builds.name: Well Swap Eunoia
builds.hinweis: Weapons are up to your team.
builds.warum: Eunoia with Hellion clears adds. Swap to Boots of the Assembler before DPS to place Well of Radiance for the team.

plan.grund: Grenade kills reduce damage taken and build Heavy ammo.
Heals on rapid Solar kills and boosts Solar weapons.

builds.name: Prismatic Artist
builds.warum: Getaway Artist turns your Arc grenade into an Arc Soul turret. Hellion and Devour give survivability and add clear.

plan.grund: Elemental kills stack Transcendence energy, and grenades during Transcendence spend it for bonus energy.
Mixed Light and Dark kills raise Grenade or Melee stat.
Grenade kills reduce damage taken and build Heavy ammo.

builds.name: Infinite Chaos
builds.hinweis: Primary and Heavy are free picks.
builds.warum: Geomag Stabilizers extends Chaos Reach and refuels it with Ionic Traces. Delicate Tomb creates Traces fast, so the Super returns within seconds.

plan.grund: Named by the source. Jolt kills create Ionic Traces.
Final blows during Super refund Super energy.
Boosts Super stat, and ability kills spawn Arc moths.

builds.name: Feed the Swarm
builds.hinweis: Primary weapons with Hatchling are recommended.
builds.warum: Swarmers create Threadlings when Tangles are destroyed, and they unravel what they hit. Service of Luzaku adds healing and Mindspun Invocation builds Threadling nests.

plan.grund: Spawns Threadlings and heals from their hits.
Unraveled kills return grenade energy or Special ammo.
Extends unravel, suspend and other Strand and Solar effects.

builds.name: Hellfire
builds.hinweis: Use a Glaive in the Energy slot. Threat Level with One-Two Punch and Trench Barrel. The source also lists Ember of Dawn, which does not exist in the game, so pick your own fourth fragment.
builds.warum: A Glaive charges Warlord's Fury through Winter's Guile. Song of Flame's melee unleashes it again and again, with Threat Level between melees. The buff fades fast, so it only suits certain encounters.

plan.grund: Heals on rapid Solar kills and boosts Solar weapons.
Melee hits under Radiant, Restoration or Cure scorch targets.
Glaive and melee hits weaken enemy damage.

builds.name: Gift of the Tempest
builds.warum: Tempest Strike stacks Combination Blow fast, and Gifted Conviction's jolt resistance keeps you alive up close.

builds.name: The Transcendent Tank
builds.warum: Chaining abilities keeps damage resistance and empowered abilities up with almost any weapon.

builds.name: One-Two Grapple
builds.warum: Combination Blow x3 powers up the Grapple melee for huge damage, even on bosses.

builds.name: Stealthed Gyrfalcon
builds.warum: Kills cycle you in and out of invisibility for strong sustain and a steady overshield.

builds.name: Jolting Resolve
builds.warum: Jolting enemies builds damage resistance, and weapon kills feed Transcendence.

builds.name: Come on and Slam
builds.warum: Stoicism stacks several Titan exotic perks into one explosive melee build.

plan.grund: Recommended 4-piece set (Prophecy dungeon).

builds.name: Wormgod's Roar
builds.warum: Wormgod Caress's melee buff reaches 400% and stacks cleanly with Roaring Flames.

plan.grund: Recommended 2-piece bonus.

builds.name: Arc Overload
builds.warum: Trickle-charge weapons with Storm's Keep give heavy sustained boss damage.

builds.name: Super Supreme
builds.warum: High Super and Weapons plus Eternal Warrior push burst boss damage hard.

plan.grund: Recommended 4-piece set.

builds.name: Choir of None
builds.warum: War Rig's auto rifle buff stacks from Choir of One kills for damage and ammo.

plan.grund: Recommended 4-piece set.
2-piece alternative.

builds.name: Radiant Assassin
builds.hinweis: Any Solar primary works; the source suggests Yeartide Apex.
builds.warum: Assassin's Cowl turns melee kills into invisibility and healing; chaining Knife Trick kills keeps it running.

builds.name: Temporal Teleporter
builds.hinweis: Ascension instead of Winter's Shroud also works.
builds.warum: Graviton Spike's form switch plus Mask of Bakris' Light Shift keep dodge energy flowing from kills, so you are hard to pin down in Grandmasters.

builds.name: Gunpowder Guru
waffen: A weapon matching your grenade element
builds.hinweis: Relativism with Spirit of Verity.
builds.warum: Spirit of Verity: weapon kills stack Death Throes up to x5, which doubles the damage of the Gunpowder Gamble grenade.

builds.name: Grasps of Duskfield
builds.warum: Renewal Grasps makes Duskfields much bigger: allies inside get Frost Armor, enemies inside deal less damage. Whisper of Shards gives grenade energy when Stasis crystals shatter (Headstone makes crystals), so Duskfields keep coming; Whisper of Chains adds damage resistance near crystals.

builds.name: The Threaded Maelstrom
builds.hinweis: Shackle Grenade is stronger in hard content, Grapple is more fun (per the source).
builds.warum: Cyrtarachne's Facade gives Woven Mail after every grapple, so you stay tanky. Thread of Transmutation makes Tangles from Strand weapon kills, and Whirling Maelstrom turns those Tangles into Threaded Maelstroms.

builds.name: The OP Stormdancer

plan.grund: Set bonus named in the source build.

builds.warum: Arc Soul and Ionic Sentry jolt everything, and through Spark of Shock that keeps a field of jolt running, which charges Stormtrance very fast. Rift → Ionic Sentry → repeat until Super; Praxic Blade handles tough targets and Barrier Champions.

builds.name: The Greatest Solar Titan

plan.grund: 10% damage resistance at all times thanks to constant Cure and Restoration (per source).

builds.warum: Melee loop: Roaring Flames and Wormgod Caress both raise melee damage, and triple Heavy Handed makes Orbs constantly. Constant Cure and Restoration keep you alive.

builds.name: Praxic Blade Void Titan Nuke
builds.warum: Spam Shield Throw, pick up Void Breaches, clean up with Sentinel Shield, and swing Praxic Blade when nothing else is up. Second Chance weakens targets, which restarts the Void loop of the artifact perks (Weaken → Breaches → Devour).

builds.name: Radiant Devourer
builds.warum: Assassin's Cowl's invisibility counts as a Void buff for Singularity Blade, so Knife Trick kills apply Weaken and give Devour through Power from Pain. Loop: 10 stacks of On Your Mark, melee kills for Devour, then Praxic Blade for constant Ignitions.

builds.name: Unkillable Stasis Wraith

plan.grund: Dungeon set, strongly raises ability regen; blocking with the sword triggers the bonus (per source).

builds.warum: Shatterdive plus Glacier Grenade gives maximum Frost Armor when you shatter. Sage Protector speeds up all abilities, and the source pairs Mask of Bakris with Praxic Blade for extra damage.

builds.name: Revolutionary Strand Hunter

plan.grund: Builds grenade and class ability energy together with Praxic Blade (per source).

builds.hinweis: Uses the Moth grenade from the Renegades artifact (per source). No exotic armor named in the source.
builds.warum: Ensnaring Slam gives Woven Mail and suspends; the moths give a Void overshield and blind. Sage Protector and Praxic Blade keep grenade and class ability coming.

builds.name: Lucky Raspberry Infinite Spam
builds.warum: Lucky Raspberry gives grenade energy every time you jolt something, so Arcbolt Grenade, Tempest Strike and Ascension chain into each other. With Dielectric, killing jolted targets heals you.

builds.name: Shadow Hunter
builds.hinweis: The source does not name the exotic armor, only its effect (longer invisibility, faster ability regen while invisible).
builds.warum: Invisibility loop: Stylish Executioner and On the Prowl keep you invisible, and invisibility speeds up grenade, melee and class ability. Praxic Blade is thrown at several targets and comes back when you attack.

builds.name: Ashen Wake Perfected

plan.grund: Named in the source build.
Raid set named in the source build.

builds.hinweis: From the Edge of Fate season (Jul 2025); its artifact perks may no longer be available.
builds.quelle: Profane on Mobalytics (Jul 2025, Edge of Fate)
builds.warum: Ashen Wake makes Fusion Grenades explode on impact and refunds grenade energy on kills. Grenade kills build Roaring Flames, then grenades go on big targets; Melas Panoplia is a weaker alternative (per source).

builds.name: Winter's Surge
builds.warum: Winter's Guile: melee and finisher kills stack melee damage, and at max stacks your melee recharges much faster. That turns Lightning Surge into the main weapon; Feed the Void's Devour heals you on kills.

builds.name: Ultimate Chromatic Fire

plan.grund: Set named in the source build.

builds.hinweis: Chromatic Fire takes the element of your Super, so any Super works: Void weakens, Solar scorches, Arc blinds, Stasis slows, Strand severs. The source runs Nova Bomb (Void).
builds.warum: Kills with Kinetic weapons (Wish-Ender) set off Chromatic Fire explosions in your Super's element, and chained kills make them bigger. Feed the Void and the Threadlings from Weaver's Call add healing and extra damage.

builds.name: The OG Prismatic Spam
builds.warum: Mataiodoxía: enemies hit by Arcane Needle explode and suspend when they die, and killing suspended enemies gives melee energy back, so the needles keep coming and fill Transcendence; Khvostov ricochets fill the rest. Needlestorm is saved for tough targets.

builds.name: Void Surge
builds.hinweis: From July 2025 (Edge of Fate launch).
builds.warum: Felwinter's Helm: powered melee hits weaken, and melee kills release a burst that weakens everything nearby. Lightning Surge hits a whole line of enemies, so one melee weakens a group for your weapons.

builds.name: Rime-Control
builds.hinweis: From August 2025; artifact perks are from that season.
builds.warum: Rime-coat Raiment gives your Bleak Watcher turrets more range, crystals and a storm; standing in the storm gives you icicles that slow whatever you shoot. Play defensive (turret at your feet) or offensive (turret into the enemy group, crystals spawn there).

builds.name: Plunder's God Mode Titan

plan.grund: Set named in the source build.

builds.warum: No Backup Plans: shotgun and melee kills start health regen, and while you have a Void overshield your shotgun hits harder and kills extend the overshield. Slayer's Fang (shotgun) adds Truesight, faster reloads and weakening submunitions on kills.

builds.name: Tommy's Splendor
builds.hinweis: From July 2025 (Edge of Fate launch). The source uses the Force Converter set bonus.
builds.warum: Loreley Splendor Helm: with a Solar Super, casting your Barricade (or getting low with a full class ability) drops a Sunspot. Sol Invictus Sunspots heal you and speed up your abilities, and Solar kills keep the loop going.

builds.name: Actium War Rigs Perfected
waffen: Any Auto Rifle or Machine Gun
builds.hinweis: From July 2025 (Edge of Fate launch); artifact perks are from that season.
builds.warum: Actium War Rig reloads Auto Rifles and Machine Guns while you shoot, and kills with them raise their damage. Thunderlord kills call lightning that gives Bolt Charge. Loop: Barricade down, then just keep shooting.

builds.name: Best Arc Warlock
builds.warum: Vesper of Radius: your Rift releases Arc shockwaves that blind with an Arc Super, and the Rift recharges faster when you're surrounded. Arc Soul and Ionic Sentry jolt everything nearby, and through Spark of Shock and Discharge that turns into Ionic Traces and constant ability energy; Thunderlord kills add Bolt Charge.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Exodus Down / Luminopotent pieces.

builds.name: Cyclical Trance
builds.warum: Stormdancer's Brace: Stormtrance hits and kills raise its damage, it refunds Super energy when it ends, and ability damage while amplified gives Bolt Charge. Electrostatic Mind keeps you amplified, so the next Stormtrance comes back fast.
builds.hinweis: Source uses the Iron Battalion set.

builds.name: Definitive Chaos
builds.warum: Geomag Stabilizers: collecting Ionic Traces gives Chaos Reach energy and damaging with Chaos Reach extends it. Loop (per source): grenades and class ability, Ionic Sentry when ready, collect every Ionic Trace, cast Chaos Reach constantly; any jolting weapon helps make more traces.

builds.name: Delicate Chaos
builds.warum: Geomag Stabilizers turn every Ionic Trace into Chaos Reach energy (per source about 7% Super each after the buff, so ~14 traces = a full Super). Delicate Tomb makes Ionic Traces on kills, so Chaos Reach comes back in seconds.

builds.name: Best Well-Lock
builds.warum: Mantle of Battle Harmony: Solar weapon kills and damage charge your Super, and with a full Super you get a Solar weapon damage bonus instead, so Well of Radiance comes up for every damage phase. Per source, add a damage-reduction set like Exodus Down or Smoke Jumper.

builds.name: Sunbracers Infinite Grenades
builds.warum: Sunbracers: Solar melee kills give unlimited Solar Grenade energy for a short time and make Solar Grenades last longer. Celestial Fire kills open the window, then you spam Solar Grenades.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Techsec / Smoke Jumper pieces (Wrecker bonus).

builds.name: Definitive Ignition
builds.warum: Dawn Chorus: Daybreak ignites on impact, Scorch does more damage and builds stronger Ignitions, and Scorch/Ignition damage gives melee energy. Loop: ignite with everything, watch the Ignitions chain, Daybreak for more. Any scorching weapon works (per source).
builds.hinweis: Source uses Seventh Seraph pieces.

builds.name: Dark Blink Insanity
builds.warum: Astrocyte Verse: Blink (and the air-dodge Dark Blink) goes farther, recharges faster, makes nearby enemies volatile and gives Volatile Rounds. Blink into a pack, everything explodes; Feed the Void and Child of the Old Gods heal you.

builds.name: Obsidian Mind
builds.warum: Skull of Dire Ahamkara: after a Nova Bomb you get a free Nova Bomb: Lance, and kills while Devour is active give Super energy. Feed the Void keeps Devour up, so the Nova Bombs keep coming.
builds.hinweis: Source uses the Iron Battalion set.

builds.name: Devouring Sin
builds.warum: Nezarec's Sin: Void kills speed up all ability recharge, and enemies hit by Soul Siphon are suppressed. Child of the Old Gods with Soul Siphon drains enemies and feeds energy back, so Void kills keep everything recharging.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Eutechnology pieces.

builds.name: Vortex God
builds.warum: Contraverse Hold: you take less damage while charging a Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant, and charged grenades refund grenade energy on hit and weaken. Feed the Void kills refund even more, so Vortex Grenades never run out.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Techsec pieces (Wrecker bonus).

builds.name: Ultimate Strand Warlock
builds.warum: Mataiodoxía: enemies hit by Arcane Needle explode and suspend on death, and killing suspended enemies gives melee energy back, so you keep throwing needles. Barrow-Dyad and the Strand fragments add Threadlings on top.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Seventh Seraph pieces.

builds.name: Definitive Army
builds.warum: Swarmers: destroying a Tangle spawns a Threadling, and your Threadlings unravel what they hit. Weaver's Call and Mindspun Invocation add more Threadlings; Service of Luzaku keeps the army healing and hitting.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Thunderhead pieces.

builds.name: Lightning Surge God
builds.warum: Necrotic Grip: melee hits inflict corruption that ramps up and spreads on kills. Lightning Surge hits a whole line of enemies, so one melee poisons a group; Feed the Void heals you on kills.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Exodus Down pieces.

builds.name: Definitive Buddies
builds.warum: Getaway Artist: your Arc grenade turns into an Arc Soul turret and amplifies you. Hellion adds a second Solar buddy, so two turrets fight for you while Feed the Void heals.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Thunderhead pieces.

builds.name: Sigma Stormtrance Spam
builds.warum: Stormdancer's Brace refunds Super energy when Stormtrance ends; per source, together with the 4-piece Iron Battalion set you get 60–75% of your Super back, and Microcosm adds even more.
builds.hinweis: Needs the Iron Battalion set (Iron Banner).

builds.name: Warmind Raiment
builds.warum: Rime-coat Raiment: Bleak Watcher turrets get more range plus crystals and a storm; standing in the storm gives icicles that slow what you shoot. Ice Breaker shatters the crystals.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Seventh Seraph pieces.

builds.name: Perfected Poison
builds.warum: Solipsism (exotic class item) with Spirit of Necrotic: melee hits inflict corruption that spreads when poisoned enemies die. The source pairs it with Spirit of Synthoceps and the Blinding Jolts artifact perk.
builds.hinweis: Exotic class item rolls: Spirit of Necrotic + Spirit of Synthoceps.

builds.name: Super Easy Bolt Charge
builds.warum: Crest of Alpha Lupi: casting your Barricade (and fighting from behind it) sends out healing pulses, and healing allies gives Barricade energy back. Per source: Barricade, win, repeat; lots of healing and team support with the Bolt Charge loop.

builds.name: Thundercrash DPS
builds.warum: Cuirass of the Falling Star: Thundercrash does much more damage and gives damage resistance after impact, and melee kills while amplified give Super energy. Built for burst damage on bosses.

builds.name: Khepri's Burst
builds.warum: Khepri's Horn: Solar kills recharge your Barricade, and with a Solar Super casting it sends out waves that scorch enemies and leave Sunspots. Barricade → waves → kills → Barricade again.

builds.name: Hinokami Protocol
builds.warum: Hallowfire Heart: with your Solar Super charged, ability kills cure you and build Sunfire Furnace stacks. Per source: get 10 stacks first, apply a debuff (e.g. Slice), then cast Burning Maul with all buffs up for burst damage.

builds.name: Solar DPS Ability
builds.warum: Hallowfire Heart: while your Solar Super is charged, ability kills cure you and give Sunfire Furnace stacks that speed up grenade and class ability. You keep the Super for the boss and play on abilities until then.

builds.name: Vortex Gatling
builds.warum: Armamentarium: an extra grenade charge, grenade kills drop Orbs, weapon kills give grenade energy and throwing a grenade reloads your weapon. Two Vortex Grenades back to back, with Bastion overshields keeping you alive.

builds.name: Bubble 2.0
builds.warum: Helm of Saint-14: Weapons of Light stays after you leave the bubble, and while it's active kills stack The Saint; Void and Kinetic damage trigger a suppressing burst. Team support build around Ward of Dawn.

builds.name: Infinite Ammo Choir of One
builds.warum: Actium War Rig reloads Choir of One from reserves while you shoot and its kills stack a damage bonus (per source up to 15% at 10 stacks). Controlled Demolition heals on kills of volatile targets.

builds.name: Nuclear Bomb Shatters
builds.warum: Howl of the Storm and Glacier Grenade make lots of Stasis crystals, and Whisper of Fissures makes shatters much bigger. Icefall Mantle gives Frost Armor on Stasis kills and heals you. Per source, the Seventh Seraph 4-piece bonus makes the shatters even stronger.
builds.hinweis: Source uses the Seventh Seraph 4-piece bonus.

builds.name: Stasis Titan Nuke
builds.warum: Freeze and shatter: Howl of the Storm freezes a whole line, Tectonic Harvest makes shards, Whisper of Fissures makes the shatters bigger. Icefall Mantle gives Frost Armor and healing on rapid Stasis kills.

builds.name: Strand Melee DPS v2
builds.warum: Wishful Ignorance: an extra Frenzied Blade charge, Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm ramp up with each hit, and Banner of War pulses give melee energy back. Melee kill starts Banner of War, more kills stack it.

builds.name: Unkillable Strand Strongholds
builds.warum: Stronghold: sword guard stats are maxed, you take less damage while blocking, and attacking after blocking gives Restoration. Per source this is an active sword build, not "hold block": Banner of War and Woven Mail on top.
builds.hinweis: Source uses the Swordmaster set (Renegades).

builds.name: Prismatic Thunderclap DPS
builds.warum: An Insurmountable Skullfort: Arc melee kills heal you and fully restore the melee, and melee hits give Arc melee energy. Thunderclap is the boss damage; Knockout adds melee damage.

builds.name: Consecration Titan Perfected
builds.warum: Per source: three Consecrations in a row thanks to Frenzied Blade charges on Prismatic, and the Hunter's Journal artifact fits it well. Stoicism (exotic class item) makes powered melee and finisher kills explode.
builds.hinweis: Exotic class item rolls are in the source.

builds.name: Bulwark Bear
builds.warum: Ursa Furiosa (or Stoicism with Spirit of the Bear): damage blocked with the Unbreakable shield turns into grenade energy, and you move faster while guarding. Block, grenade, repeat.
builds.hinweis: Per source: Stoicism with Spirit of the Bear, or Ursa Furiosa.

builds.name: SMG x Peacekeepers
builds.warum: Peacekeepers: SMGs handle better, reload when stowed and do more damage the longer you stay on target. Per source, it works with Heat SMGs like the M-17 "Fast Talker" for long uninterrupted DPS.

builds.name: Lightning Nuke Hunter
builds.warum: Fortune's Favor: kills at full health (or time out of combat) turn your shields into an overshield, and with the overshield your weapons get better and hit harder. Tempest Strike and Combination Blow clear, Gathering Storm for the boss.

builds.name: Culling Arc Hunter
builds.warum: The Bombardiers: every dodge leaves an explosive that blinds with an Arc Super. Gambler's Dodge refunds melee, so dodge → bomb → Tempest Strike → repeat. Per source aim for 150 Melee, 100 Super, 100 Class.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Exodus Down (Nessus). Cull’s Shadow comes from the secret mission “Oblation: Bloodline”.

builds.name: Trick Bolts
builds.warum: Shinobu's Vow: an extra Skip Grenade charge, Skip Grenade damage gives Bolt Charge and Bolt Charge gives Skip Grenade energy back. When Bolt Charge is ready you heal allies and the next Skip Grenade is stronger.

builds.name: Tempest Strike Perfected
builds.warum: Gifted Conviction: Ascension and Tempest Strike throw bouncing jolt explosives, and jolting nearby enemies gives you damage resistance. Combination Blow and Gambler's Dodge keep the melee coming.

builds.name: The True Gunslinger
builds.warum: Young Ahamkara's Spine: bigger, longer Tripmines, and any ability damage gives Tripmine energy back. Knife Trick and the tripmines feed each other, On Your Mark speeds everything up.
builds.hinweis: Source uses Exodus Down for damage reduction.

builds.name: Blade Barrage DPS
builds.warum: Shards of Galanor: knife kills lower your Super cooldown, and Blade Barrage on one target explodes and refunds Super energy. Blade Barrage on the boss, Knife Trick to get it back.

builds.name: Infinite Crackshot
builds.warum: Speedloader Slacks: dodging reloads all weapons and buffs reload and handling, and sustained damage gives class ability energy back (per source very fast). Ember of Singeing returns dodge energy on scorch, so Crackshot stays active.

builds.name: Crackshot Spam
builds.warum: Radiant Dance Machines: primary weapon kills return dodge energy and can overflow into extra charges. With Sunshot every kill gives a dodge back, so the dodge buffs never stop.

builds.name: Knife God
builds.warum: Ophidia Spathe: two knives per charge, and knife kills give the next knives a stacking damage bonus that Gambler's Dodge refreshes. Per source: melee kills stack Scissor Fingers, finishers for Void overshield, keep knifing.

builds.name: Busted Bow DPS
builds.warum: Per source: after the Monument of Triumph primary buff, Hierarchy of Needs does huge damage, and Moebius Quiver boosts the bow even more. Fortune's Favor overshields buff your weapons; invisibility keeps you safe.

builds.name: Phantom Punch
builds.warum: Khepri's Sting: killing a weakened enemy releases weakening smoke and refunds Void melee energy. Phantom Surge weakens and hits several enemies, so one kill brings it straight back.

builds.name: Phantom Surge Nukes
builds.warum: Per source: the new Phantom Surge melee deals huge damage and hits multiple enemies; with Turncoat (Void hand cannon) and Radiant Dance Machines, primary kills give dodge energy back for more melee and invisibility.

builds.name: Phantom Surge Cooks
builds.warum: Graviton Forfeit: invisibility lasts longer and speeds up grenade, melee and class ability, with a Void overshield at max stacks. Everything here makes Phantom Surge as strong as possible (per source).
builds.hinweis: Mobalytics lists no melee; the source says to equip Phantom Surge.

builds.name: Insane Void Hunter DPS
builds.warum: Per source: Moebius Quiver plus a hot-swap rotation with the Envious Arsenal crossbow for clean, high boss damage; Fortune's Favor overshields buff weapon damage.

builds.name: Strand 4 Grenades
builds.warum: Widow's Silk gives Grapple an extra charge, and Mothkeeper's Wraps turns kills into moth cages you throw as your grenade: moths blind enemies or protect allies. Whirling Maelstrom and Barrow-Dyad add Strand damage in between.

builds.name: Clone GM Hunter
builds.warum: Threaded Specter leaves a decoy clone that draws fire, and Speedloader Slacks makes every dodge reload your weapons and buff reload/handling for the team. Safe, steady play for Grandmasters.

builds.name: Prismatic Tether DPS
builds.warum: Orpheus Rig: you get ability energy back for every enemy tethered by Deadfall, so a big tether on a pack refills your abilities.

builds.name: Prismatic DPS God Mode
builds.warum: Liar's Handshake: after your Arc melee (or getting hit by a melee) you get a huge healing counterpunch. Combination Blow stacks make the punches even stronger.

neutral.grund: After time out of combat, your next kill gives ammo and an Orb.
Shield breaks pull in nearby Orbs and ammo.
Orb pickups give brief damage reduction.
Shield regen gives flinch and damage resistance.
